description: Public paper surface: arXiv 1706.03762 with page, paragraph, and excerpt locators on the original article.

atoms.text: The Transformer is a transduction model based solely on attention, dispensing with recurrence and convolutions.

refs.excerpt: We propose a new simple network architecture, the Transformer, based solely on attention mechanisms, dispensing with recurrence and convolutions entirely.

provenance.source_excerpt: We propose a new simple network architecture, the Transformer, based solely on attention mechanisms, dispensing with recurrence and convolutions entirely.

atoms.text: Scaled dot-product attention in the Transformer divides query-key products by the square root of the key dimension so softmax stays out of vanishing-gradient regions.

refs.excerpt: To counteract this effect, we scale the dot products by 1/√d_k.

provenance.source_excerpt: To counteract this effect, we scale the dot products by 1/√d_k.

atoms.text: Multi-head attention lets the Transformer jointly attend to information from different representation subspaces at different positions.

refs.excerpt: Multi-head attention allows the model to jointly attend to information from different representation subspaces at different positions.

provenance.source_excerpt: Multi-head attention allows the model to jointly attend to information from different representation subspaces at different positions.
